rca_of_the_issue: The AuthModal component in the frontend appears to have a state management issue. When the login API returns 200 OK with a valid token, the modal should: 1) Store the token in localStorage, 2) Update React state to close the modal, 3) Redirect to the requested page. Currently, step 2 (closing the modal) is not happening. The backend is working correctly - the issue is purely in the frontend React component.
